decisions.decision: Files identified by SHA-256 only. Qortuba df0e1d69, P7757 ab54dd55, ST7757 9f9d1179 found; no re-upload requested.

Writer, decoder and source metadata are recorded as three separate facts. All three DXFs: DXF_WRITER = AUTOCAD_OR_ODA_FAMILY_FORMAT, DWG_DECODER = CONVERTER_UNKNOWN, SOURCE_METADATA_LASTSAVEDBY = 'Msalf'.

Qortuba DXF is SAME_LINEAGE_DIFFERENT_REVISION of DWG 2ec3a9c8 (same FINGERPRINTGUID, different VERSIONGUID, +45,537 s editing time, 21 measured entities missing, 19 added in the plan region): SOURCE_FIDELITY_FAIL against 2ec3a9c8, NOT_ESTABLISHED against its own DWG, admission REJECTED.
P7757 and ST7757 DXFs: SOURCE_FIDELITY_PASS (P7757: 5966/5966 model-space entities same handle/type/layer; geometry PASS; 0x929 kept as ARC_DIMENSION), class HIGH_FIDELITY_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED_DXF.
No signature qualified (Qortuba 0/10, P7757 0). Every signature reads PROVENANCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT with its diagnostic outcome kept beside it. No numerical-percentage qualification.
ST7757 is structural supporting evidence only; nothing from it enters architectural quantities.
The owner's unit claim stays bound to 2ec3a9c8; it is not transferred to the DXF or the later DWG.
Plan selection: bottom-most layout = PLAN_VARIANT_4_SELECTED_CANDIDATE, the same title handle and position as the measured plan. A candidate only; the designation stays PENDING_OWNER.
K2 (ezdxf route) fixed to read optional attributes without raising (RTEXT has no layer in ezdxf): one unknown entity type no longer stops the route. SHADOW code; no quantity path touched.
Next coding round: A (CANONICAL_MEASUREMENT_INPUT contract, fail-closed) now; independent qualification (B) when a conversion record and the right Qortuba DWG arrive.
MIGRATION_PLANNING_READY = YES (round 1 must be re-anchored after the revision decision); MIGRATION_EXECUTION_READY = NO; PRODUCTION_MIGRATION = NO.

canonical_input_contract_review.lesson: identical segments with lossy provenance changed HALL 36.37 -> 25.0925 m2 (R8.6 ablation)

fields.field: block identity along the instance path
fields.how: block names derived from the K1 instance path (D1 INSERT -> block record)
sub_id = hash(K1 obs id + canonical coordinates): unique within one decode, NOT stable across revisions or after any coordinate change
D1 TEXT/MTEXT placed through K1 instance paths (lab mapping)
K1 removes hidden entities into rg.hidden; the method input carries no visibility flag
one primitive per K1 segment / arc / circle with its lineage

canonical_input_contract_review.gap: the method accepts a primitive with a blank block path or colliding part id and silently changes rooms; no input declares its required provenance
canonical_input_contract_review.proposal: CANONICAL_MEASUREMENT_INPUT: each method declares the provenance fields it reads; the adapter refuses (fail closed, named field) when a declared field is absent or not unique; part id = (source handle, instance path, part index), never a coordinate hash
why: B cannot start: no DXF has proven decoder provenance and the Qortuba DXF is the wrong revision
A is fully inside our control and removes a proven silent-error path (HALL 36.37 -> 25.09)
A defines what a qualified parser must deliver, so B qualifies against the real contract
C would couple an internal change with an external dependency and stall on the external part

findings.finding: the Qortuba drawing has moved on: the owner's current file is a later revision than the DWG the six rows were measured on; 10 round-1 source observations are gone (HALL, BED.ROOM 18.7525, BATH 5.1, UNLABELLED 4.51 are built from them). Approving the R8.6 rows as baseline now would freeze an outdated drawing

the owner's 'four stacked layouts' description fits the later revision, not the measured DWG (one layout). A designation answer must bind to one exact hash; 'last' is ambiguous (bottom-most vs most recently created copy 0x3690)

the three DXFs were written within 14 minutes on a machine with a UTC+3 clock, by a program that keeps TDINDWG and writes AC1032 with ACDSDATA; P7757/ST7757 were open 21 s / 10 s. This narrows the story (a desktop CAD program, not a Python library) but names no tool: still CONVERTER_UNKNOWN
sub_id in the canonical rebuild hashes coordinates: unique within a decode but not stable across revisions. A cross-revision comparison must correlate by handle + instance path, never by sub_id
the K2 route raised on RTEXT (no 'layer' attribute in ezdxf) and stopped for the whole document; fixed so the entity reaches the UNHANDLED finding
intake paths under the session upload folder were kept out of frozen truth: registers record file names and hashes only, tests read committed registers
the Qortuba DXF declares $INSUNITS 5 (cm) like the DWG; that agreement is not a confirmation for the later revision, which needs its own owner unit claim
